Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 28 Cooks River West

Clause 9.28.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.28.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect the identified Heritage Items within the precinct.

Clause 9.28.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.28.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect groups or runs of building which retain their original built form including roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.28.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect significant streetscapes and/or public domain elements within the precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.28.2 - other (development_control): Retain existing views and vistas to open space areas adjacent to the Cooks River and maintain public access to those areas.

Clause 9.28.2 - other (development_control): To ensure that new development in the foreshore area will not impact on natural foreshore processes or affect the significance and amenity of the area.

Clause 9.28.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): To preserve the predominantly low and medium density residential character of the precinct.
